# oriz-text

> Writing-desk text toolkit. Case convert, word/char/line count, dedupe & sort lines, slugify, lorem ipsum, reverse, remove extra spaces, find & replace, plus optional AI polish (grammar/summarize/rewrite/tone/translate). 100% client-side — text never leaves the browser; no upload, no signup, free. PWA-installable.

## App

- [Live app](https://text.oriz.in): the tool itself — type or drop a `.txt`, run any transform, copy or download the result.
- [Full site text](https://text.oriz.in/llms-full.txt): complete hero, feature, and how-to copy as clean markdown for LLM ingestion.

## Features

- [Case conversion](https://text.oriz.in): UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, tOGGLE cASE.
- [Programmer cases](https://text.oriz.in): camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, slugify.
- [Line tools](https://text.oriz.in): sort A→Z / Z→A / numeric, dedupe, reverse, shuffle.
- [Whitespace tools](https://text.oriz.in): trim lines, remove extra spaces, remove blank lines.
- [Reverse](https://text.oriz.in): reverse characters, reverse words.
- [Find & replace](https://text.oriz.in): literal or regex (with `$1` backrefs), optional ignore-case.
- [Lorem ipsum](https://text.oriz.in): generate paragraphs, sentences, or words.
- [Live meter](https://text.oriz.in): words, chars, chars-no-spaces, lines, sentences, paragraphs, reading time — updates as you type.
- [AI polish (optional)](https://text.oriz.in): fix grammar, summarize, rewrite, formal/casual tone, translate — keyless, loads on demand.
